verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a fellow.ai/pricing page exists and lists feature names such as AI meeting summary, transcript redaction and keyword tracking, and it mentions that paid and Enterprise plans exist. Nothing shows a free tier, any tier prices, which features belong to which tier, or whether basic use avoids a 'talk to sales' gate. The page's existence and feature names alone do not show the story's capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use
